name: rigol-ds1102e
description: Safe one- or two-probe USB acquisition, verification, analysis, and interpretation for the RIGOL DS1102E.

interface.shortDescription: Safely acquire and compare one or two probes.
interface.longDescription: Controls a USB-connected RIGOL DS1102E, qualifies one or two probe signals, preserves same-trigger CH1/CH2 captures, verifies artifacts, analyzes per-channel or paired pulse timing, restores scope state, and produces evidence-bounded reports.
defaultPrompt: Safely capture and analyze both DS1102E probes.
Wait for stable CH1 contact and analyze ten captures.
Measure CH1-to-CH2 pulse delay from verified captures.
